```yaml
name: Infisical Testing
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
```
